headline: Site control of 142 South Bend Street for a new unified high school, plus pay rate ordinances and teacher contract referrals.
summary: The council will consider giving the school committee site control of 142 South Bend Street for a new unified high school. It will also take up pay rate changes, a new Parking Enforcement Officer position, and several damage claims.
items: Mayor's letter to Dr. Christina Pacheco, CEO, Blackstone Valley Community Health Care Center (Pawtucket Soup Kitchen)
Mayor's letter confirming Ann-Marie McGee to the Pension Board
Pawtucket High School construction report from Colliers Project Leaders
Statement of estimated, realized and unrealized revenues for July 1, 2026 through July 31, 2026
Response on The Elisha Project and Downtown Gateway Development
Response on stop signs on Rice Street
Contract between the Pawtucket School Committee and Pawtucket Teachers' Alliance, Local 930, for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2029, referred to Finance Committee
Personnel Board recommendation on Teamsters Local 251 new contract and pay plan effective July 1, 2026, referred to Finance Committee
Ordinance replacing pay rates for Local 251 in Section §88-12 (Teamsters 2026-2029), laid on the table and referred to Finance Committee
Request for approval and Personnel Board recommendation to establish a Parking Enforcement Officer position, referred to Finance Committee
Ordinance replacing pay rates for Local 3960 in Section §88-12 (Add: Parking Enforcement Officer), laid on the table and referred to Finance Committee

Eight damage claims referred to the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits: Carrie Cardoso – $350.14 (Tire); Sherry Marshall – $266.19 (Tire); Courtney Petter – $623.12 (Manhole); Ryan Boudreau – $374.71 (Manhole); Timothy Pacheco III – $1,717.78 (Vehicle Damage); Karen Zapata – $1,172.50 / $2,029.80 (Property Damage); Cody Tavares by Progressive Subrogation – $1,301.83 (Fire Vehicle); Antonia Ramos & Gerson Dos Santos – $2,100.00 (Vehicle Damage)
Damage claim from Oluwatoyin Wilcox – $54,100.00 (Property Damage), referred to the Law Department and RI Interlocal Trust
City Property Committee resolution providing site control of 142 South Bend Street to the Pawtucket School Committee for construction of a new unified high school

Committee on Claims and Pending Suits returns six damage claims: Lisa Jones – $300.00 (Pothole); Norka Quezada – $1,350.00 (Pothole); Juan Hernandez – $680.96 (Pothole); Bernard Donald Grossi, Jr. – $140.00 (Tow); Megan Loiselle – $375.00 (Vehicle Damage); Irma Velez-Parent – $94.00 (Property Damage)
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 2nd Floor – Temporary Council Chambers, enter parking lot at 75 Sabin Street
